description:
Spotlight Bible Verse Wallpaper
https://github.com/IC5C7/Spotlight-Bible-Verse-Wallpaper

Bible Wallpaper for Wallpaper Engine and Lively Wallpaper

An interactive wallpaper for browsing and displaying Bible passages with customizable backgrounds. Supports built-in and downloadable translations where available.

The maintainer does not claim ownership of the Bible texts or translations.

IMPORTANT: Review security, copyright, and licensing notices before installing, running, or redistributing this package.

Releases may contain third-party software, runtimes, scripts, images, and Bible data with separate risks and usage terms. Review downloaded files before use.
Features
- Interactive Bible verse display with configurable backgrounds.
- Browser-based passage browsing.
- Built-in Bible data for offline reading, subject to applicable rights.
- Download translations for offline use.
- Store downloaded translations in browser IndexedDB.
- Import compatible JSON Bible files.
- Normal Wallpaper Engine use should not require Python, a local server, manual PowerShell/BAT execution, or a Windows startup task.
Features vary by release and platform.
System Requirements
Software
OS: Windows 10/11, 64-bit.

Primary platform: Wallpaper Engine (Steam).

Technology: HTML5 interactive wallpaper.

No separate Python installation or local server is normally required for Wallpaper Engine.

Administrator access and manual script execution are not normally required.

Windows 11 is recommended. Lively packages may have different requirements.
Hardware
Recommended:
- CPU: Intel Core i3, AMD Ryzen 3, or equivalent.
- RAM: 8 GB or more.
- Graphics: DirectX 10/11-compatible graphics.
- Storage: Approximately 50 MB or more, plus downloaded data.
- Display: 1920 × 1080 or higher.
A dedicated GPU is unnecessary. Performance depends on hardware, resolution, backgrounds, and running applications.
Supported Resolutions
Full HD: 1920 × 1080

QHD: 2560 × 1440

4K UHD: 3840 × 2160

Background images are retrieved directly from the Microsoft Windows Spotlight API v4. Available image assets can reach 4K resolution, depending on the content supplied by Microsoft. Actual image dimensions and quality may vary.

Image quality and loading performance may vary.
Internet and Offline Access
Online Bible content: Internet access is required to retrieve supported translations and passages from Bible.com.

Offline Bible content: Built-in and downloaded data work offline when stored locally.
Windows Spotlight Background Images
Background images and associated metadata are retrieved directly from the Microsoft Windows Spotlight API v4.
https://fd.api.iris.microsoft.com/v4/api/selection

The wallpaper uses image URLs supplied directly by the Microsoft Windows Spotlight API. Localized titles, descriptions, photographer credits, and attribution information are used when included in the corresponding Spotlight metadata.

The image and its metadata are obtained from the same API response. No separate English feed, cross-feed image matching, translated-title matching, photographer-credit comparison, Peapix service, third-party image metadata service, or external Spotlight gallery fallback is used.

The wallpaper does not independently search for or substitute metadata belonging to another image. Missing metadata is not treated as verified information.

Internet access is required to retrieve new Spotlight images and metadata. Browser CORS restrictions, Microsoft service availability, or upstream API changes may affect retrieval.

IMPORTANT: The Windows Spotlight API v4 endpoint is an undocumented service interface identified through analysis of Windows Spotlight network traffic. It is not a guaranteed public developer API. Its parameters, response structure, and availability may change without notice.

Downloaded translations are stored in IndexedDB and are not automatically shared between Wallpaper Engine and Lively Wallpaper. Offline Bible access does not guarantee offline access to remote images or online content. JSON compatibility depends on the release and file format.
Installation
A. Wallpaper Engine (Steam)
Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3825407599
1. Install and launch Wallpaper Engine through Steam.
2. Obtain the wallpaper from the intended release source.
3. Subscribe to or add it using the source's workflow.
4. Apply Spotlight Bible Verse Wallpaper.
5. Configure backgrounds and translations in settings, if available.
6. Verify that it works correctly.
Normal operation should not require Python, a local server, manual PowerShell/BAT execution, or a Windows startup task. Check release documentation for exceptions.
B. Lively Wallpaper
A separate compatible package may be required.
1. Install and launch Lively Wallpaper.
2. Obtain the package from a trusted source.
3. Review its contents and instructions.
4. Import index.html or another supported format through Lively.
5. Apply the wallpaper and verify its behavior.

These files may not be required for every release. Do not run executables or scripts unless you understand their purpose, trust their source, and have verified the instructions.
Bible Versions, Sources, and Copyright
The following filenames are associated with Bible versions referenced by this project. Attribution does not grant reproduction or redistribution rights.

Security Notice
Some distributions may include a Microsoft Edge WebView2 host reported to have modified security mitigations. Some protections may have been relaxed, disabled, or otherwise changed.

These changes and their security impact have not been independently audited for this project. Packages containing these components may carry serious security risks.
